title: Tacoomah Makes a Dance
year_evidence: 扉に『PUBLISHED BY THE AMERICAN FOLK-LORE SOCIETY … 1924』、序文の署名に『April, 1924.』
text:
William Forbes, Dry River, Cock-pit country.

Tacoomah make a dance, get Anansi for de fiddler, an’ Grass-quit was
coming as a fiddler too. Robin Redbreast was to play de music, Monkey
was to blow de bugle. Well, after de night de dance commence. Anansi
gwine to play,

   “Queena bunna, ring-ki-ting,
    You sen’ fe great Grass-quit,
    You don’ sen’ fe me!
    Anansi draw bow so sweet, ring-ki-ting,
    Anansi draw bow so sweet, ring-ki-ting.”

Tacoomah say,

   “You ya, you ya, so ya, me ya,
    Wid a fort tumba like a tenky bunna,
    Wid a jump, wid a jump, like a tenky bunna.” [64]

Robin Redbreast say,

   “Jock, Jock, when you coming home?”

Jock said,

   “Tomorrow evening.”
   “What in your right?”
   “Boot an’ spur.”
   “What in your left?”
   “Bow an’ arrow. [65]”

Jock [66] said,

   “Robin redbreast
    Was pretty well dressed,
    And he was into his nest,
    And a puppy went into his nest
    And broke his neck t’ru distress.”

Well, den, Turtle an’ Duck goin’ in de river fe go an’ swim, an’ dem is
to run to a hill-side in de river. An’ Cock is de judge. Den Cock went
to sing fe dem—

   “Co co re co.”

Duck an’ Turtle swim—

   “Shekey, shekey, shee-e-e.”
paragraphs: William Forbes, Dry River, Cock-pit country.

Tacoomah make a dance, get Anansi for de fiddler, an’ Grass-quit was coming as a fiddler too. Robin Redbreast was to play de music, Monkey was to blow de bugle. Well, after de night de dance commence. Anansi gwine to play,
“Queena bunna, ring-ki-ting, You sen’ fe great Grass-quit, You don’ sen’ fe me! Anansi draw bow so sweet, ring-ki-ting, Anansi draw bow so sweet, ring-ki-ting.”
Tacoomah say,
“You ya, you ya, so ya, me ya, Wid a fort tumba like a tenky bunna, Wid a jump, wid a jump, like a tenky bunna.” [64]
Robin Redbreast say,
“Jock, Jock, when you coming home?”
Jock said,
“Tomorrow evening.” “What in your right?” “Boot an’ spur.” “What in your left?” “Bow an’ arrow. [65]”
Jock [66] said,
“Robin redbreast Was pretty well dressed, And he was into his nest, And a puppy went into his nest And broke his neck t’ru distress.”
Well, den, Turtle an’ Duck goin’ in de river fe go an’ swim, an’ dem is to run to a hill-side in de river. An’ Cock is de judge. Den Cock went to sing fe dem—
“Co co re co.”
Duck an’ Turtle swim—
“Shekey, shekey, shee-e-e.”
語り手 ウィリアム・フォーブズ(コックピット地方、ドライ・リヴァー)
タクーマが踊りの会を開き、アナンシを弾き手に頼み、グラスキット(小鳥)も弾き手として来ることになった。駒鳥が囃し、猿がラッパを吹くことになった。さて夜になって踊りが始まった。アナンシが弾く。
「クイーナ・ブンナ、リンキ・ティン、大したグラスキットは呼びに行って、おれは呼びに来ねえ! アナンシの弓はこんなに甘い、リンキ・ティン、アナンシの弓はこんなに甘い、リンキ・ティン」
タクーマが言う。
「ユー・ヤ、ユー・ヤ、ソー・ヤ、ミー・ヤ、フォート・タンバでテンキ・ブンナのように、ひと跳び、ひと跳び、テンキ・ブンナのように」 [64]
駒鳥が言う。
「ジョック、ジョック、いつ家に帰る?」
ジョックが言った。
「明日の晩に」。「右手に何を持ってる?」「長靴と拍車」。「左手に何を持ってる?」「弓と矢 [65]」
ジョック [66] が言った。
「駒鳥はめかしこんで、巣に入っていた。すると子犬が巣に入ってきて、駒鳥は気を揉んで首の骨を折った」
さて、それから亀と鴨が川へ泳ぎに行き、川のなかの丘のふもとまで競走することになった。雄鶏が行司である。そこで雄鶏が二匹のために歌った——
「コ・コ・レ・コ」
鴨と亀が泳ぐ——
「シェキー、シェキー、シー——」
